params.name: iterations
params.why: Upper bound only; early stopping decides the real count.

params.name: learning_rate
params.why: Small steps (η in f4): more trees, smoother fit, less overfitting.

params.name: depth
params.why: CatBoost's default; oblivious trees of depth 6 capture up to 6-way interactions.

params.name: early_stopping_rounds
params.why: Stop when validation AUC has not improved for 50 rounds. Stopped at 252 trees.

params.name: eval_metric
params.why: We rank clients; AUC measures ranking quality directly.

params.name: auto_class_weights
params.why: Only 11.27% subscribe; reweighting stops the loss being dominated by 'no'.

params.name: cat_features
params.why: Passed natively — no one-hot. CatBoost encodes them with ordered target statistics (f1).

params.name: random_seed
params.why: Fixes the permutation used for ordered statistics, so results are reproducible.
